title: Time-frequency Talbot effect as Clifford operations on entangled time-frequency GKP states
summary: The Talbot effect -- a near-field diffraction phenomenon in which a periodic wavefront self-images at regular distances -- can be transposed to the time--frequency domain via the space--time duality between diffraction and dispersive broadening. We exploit this analogy to define the time--frequency (TF) Talbot effect and show that it implements different Clifford operations on TF Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (TF-GKP) qubits (Phys.
